changes.title: AgentCore runtime instances now support Nested Virtualization
changes.detail: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore runtime instances now support nested virtualization, so your agents can run their own virtual machines and emulators inside a session with Kernel-based Virtual Machine (KVM). Runtime instances run your agents on Amazon EC2 instances while AgentCore handles provisioning, patching, scaling, and lifecycle management. Nested virtualization serves agents that rely on tools that run in a virtual machine, such as mobile emulators or virtual machine sandboxes.
